games.title: Flappy Bird — Dash

games.controls: Space / Click / Tap to flap · P/Esc pause · R restart · H guide · T story · K scores · M mute

games.title: Cờ Toán: Bàn Cờ Sống
games.blurb: A 3D tabletop adaptation of Vietnamese Math Chess — move numbered stones, form adjacent arithmetic pairs, and capture the opposing 0.
games.controls: Arrow keys / WASD move cursor · Enter / Space select · 1–4 choose +/−/×/÷ · phone stick + action pad (landscape)

games.title: Night Spin
games.blurb: Party roulette for social nights — numbers, Truth or Dare, xúc xắc, or your own dares. A real bowl: the ball rides the track, drops off a diamond and rattles into a pocket.
games.controls: Space or SPIN · ↑ ↓ switch mode · ← → preset or N · cog for duration, action list & history · phone-ready (any orientation)

games.title: Orbital Linefall: Sector Run
games.blurb: Space-themed Tetris with 5 escalating sectors, T-spin mini/full adjudication, guideline DAS/ARR, comet salvage, and a 3D glass-and-neon command deck. Stabilize all five sectors by clearing 20 layers.
games.controls: ← → / A D slide · ↑ / W / X rotate · ↓ / S soft drop · Space hard drop · phone D-pad ↻/◀/▼/▶ + ⬇⬇ hard drop · compact mid-run HUD (portrait)

games.title: Switch Heist
games.blurb: Top-down night-LA bank job with a three-crook crew — switch mid-heist to crack the vault, hold the lobby, or drive, then outrun the stars to the safehouse.
games.controls: WASD / arrows move · Space fire · E enter car · F crack vault · 1–3 switch crook · phone stick (landscape) · ⛶ Full screen hides browser chrome

games.title: Arcade Bloodline
games.blurb: A 3D side-on arcade fighter where precise spacing, blocks, special moves, and a final finishing strike decide a best-of-three duel.
games.controls: Arrows move / crouch / jump · A punch · S kick · D block · ↓+A uppercut · ↓ then →+A projectile

games.title: Codex of Duty
games.blurb: A browser FPS with a streaming open world — city chunks load in as you explore, backed by Rapier 3D physics and tactical enemy AI. Plays on a phone too, with on-screen controls.
games.controls: WASD + mouse · 1–5 weapons · R reload · on-screen stick on mobile

games.title: Open Skies
games.blurb: Cockpit combat flight sim over a living low-poly island — clear six escalating sorties, survive hostile fighters and flak, then earn each advance with a safe landing.
games.controls: WASD / arrows fly · I/O throttle · Q/E rudder · Space guns · Z/X ordnance · phone stick + pad (landscape) · ⛶ Full screen hides browser chrome

games.controls: ← → / A D strafe · W / Space jump & place block · S mine · Mouse aim · Shift sprint · P pause · H guide · M mute · R restart · phone stick + ⚡/🎮/🔨 buttons (landscape)
